method: Locally opened 600x720 game photos; verified Commons file description, photographer, source, permission and work-credit where available.

eighteenPersonSummary.note: Among the ORIGINAL 18 photos: 12 earlier rejections unchanged, two approvals and four new rejections. A SEPARATE 2026 portrait for 李妍瑾 is additionally approved, so three distinct people are staged.

decisions.name: 葛民輝

replacementApproved.name: 李妍瑾
replacementApproved.reason: 2026 studio front-facing single-person portrait, no obstruction or second face, 600x720 automated face crop reviewed. Automatic Laplacian sharpness ~27.6 is artificially low on smoothed studio photography, but eyes, nose, lips and chin are distinctly visible by human review. Exempt this specific photo from the 65 blanket threshold only with human approval; do not globally loosen quality gate.

additionalApprovedFromNewPipelineRun.name: 阿喜
additionalApprovedFromNewPipelineRun.identityEvidence: Original Commons description says 林育品（阿喜）擔任金士頓科技廣告代言人; used on 林育品 biography and depicts this person.
additionalApprovedFromNewPipelineRun.reason: 600x720 face crop with readable eyes (gaze up), nose, mouth and chin; no sunglasses, mask, microphone, second face or watermark; recognition from 2013 public appearance.

additionalRejectedFalseMatch.name: 喜翔
additionalRejectedFalseMatch.reason: Caption identifies Jason King, Dean of USC Thornton School of Music, not Taiwanese actor 喜翔; English alias collision. Never publish.
additionalRejectedFalseMatch.fix: Require positive image-adjacent caption subject matching the specific Wikidata identity; filename or translated English alias alone must not be treated as proof.

pipelineFixes: Treat 403/proxy_access_denied as a blocked source, log host and retry-after; do not hammer the same endpoint or interpret it as no image.
Distinguish cirrussearch-too-busy-error from no results and back off with bounded retries.
Require subject-level visual/photo-adjacent caption evidence; reject ambiguous English names and article header-only matches.
Keep no-photo, image download failure, identity mismatch and license review concerns as separate statuses.
Generate per-candidate five-stage previews and contact sheets; do not auto-promote on face detection alone.
After acceptance, synchronize roster, eligibility-review, hint-candidates, hints, game bank, photo and attribution. Run prepare_hints and mobile QA before main.
Critically: t1500_0259 羅璧玲 is same person as live x1000_p0217 羅霈穎. Cross-bank alias/entity dedup before photo search; don't count as a new person.

additionalRejectedDuplicate.name: 羅璧玲
additionalRejectedDuplicate.reason: 羅璧玲 is the earlier name of existing 羅霈穎 (existing actor id x1000_p0217), NOT a new unique quiz person. Main now includes aliases 羅霈穎/羅璧玲/東區羅姐. Exclude this candidate from 1100 new-person counter. Commons file caption also references 周丹葳, so image-subject confirmation would require further evidence if ever used as a replacement portrait.
additionalRejectedDuplicate.verifiedBy: GitHub main actors.json and Wikidata Q9000070; Commons file description
additionalRejectedDuplicate.note: Candidate is not rejected for its technical image quality; no further photo work should be spent on this duplicate.

conclusions: New-candidate yield is at most 1/40 and 1/200, with one /40 a duplicate; fix provider effectiveness and dedup before doing more expensive retries.
Normalize person matching with all live main people across questions/actors/variety and all aliases, linked Wikidata QID, traditional/simplified names and romanizations BEFORE querying image sources.
Validate image-adjacent caption depicts target person; the 羅霈穎.JPG caption references 周丹葳, so Commons file title alone cannot establish person identity.

Independent source fetches confirmed existing Commons photos for 唐美雲 and 王耀慶 although pipeline marked download_failed. Inspect actual HTTP status and handle thumbnail URLs and redirects. However the personally inspected respective images are unsuitable: 唐美雲 2007 chef-hat and other people, 王耀慶 2011 dim grainy squinting. Seek more iconic front-facing portraits.
Before next 200-person sweep, run 10-person diagnostic batch with per-provider successful requests/eligible image counts and recorded reasons for each 403, 429, timeout, missing caption or bad crop.
Continue the 1100 goal only after source-caption-photo-license-human-review alignment. Main merges must pass Singer QA, hints QA, mobile QA and live Pages QA.
